title: Koala dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#2a3a6a' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- ear left -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='28' r='14' fill='#8a8f9e'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='28' r='9' fill='#c9cbd4'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='#8a8f9e'/>

  <!-- ear right -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='28' r='14' fill='#8a8f9e'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='28' r='9' fill='#c9cbd4'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='#8a8f9e'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#9a9fae'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#c9cbd4'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='24' fill='#a3a8b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#c9cbd4'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#4a4e63'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44.5' rx='4' ry='2.2' fill='#6a6e86'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='36' r='4' fill='#2a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='36' r='4' fill='#2a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#8fe3ff'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#8fe3ff'/>

  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M44 54 Q50 59 56 54' stroke='#4a4e63' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- left arm raised up -->
  <path d='M30 62 Q16 50 14 34' stroke='#9a9fae' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='32' r='5' fill='#c9cbd4'/>

  <!-- right arm raised other way -->
  <path d='M70 62 Q84 48 88 38' stroke='#9a9fae' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='36' r='5' fill='#c9cbd4'/>

  <!-- left leg kicking -->
  <path d='M42 88 Q34 94 28 90' stroke='#9a9fae' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='89' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#c9cbd4'/>

  <!-- right leg planted -->
  <path d='M58 88 Q64 95 70 92' stroke='#9a9fae' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='91' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#c9cbd4'/>

  <!-- musical notes -->
  <g fill='#ffd866'>
    <path d='M18 18 v8 a3 3 0 1 0 3 3 v-9 l6-2 v6 a3 3 0 1 0 3 3 v-10 z'/>
    <circle cx='21' cy='27' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='24' r='2.5'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#7fffd4'>
    <circle cx='78' cy='16' r='2.5'/>
    <path d='M78 16 v-8 l5 1.5' stroke='#7fffd4' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none'/>
  </g>
</svg>
